datasets.name: contracts
datasets.note: OverTheCap historical contracts via nflverse. Kept when gsis_id is present and the signed term covers one of the ingest seasons 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026. years null is not given a guessed length.

datasets.name: rosters
datasets.note: Season rows and weekly rows share the file. roster_level tells them apart. A blank gsis_id is refused.

datasets.name: snap-counts
datasets.note: This release has game_id and pfr_player_id. It has no gsis_id column, so none was added.

datasets.name: participation-2018
datasets.note: Season 2018. 2023 and later is FTN Data via nflverse, CC-BY-SA 4.0. players_on_field is players_on_play split on commas, else offense_players plus defense_players. Blank cells stay null (4153 kept rows). Internal storage. Not a commercial display.
